      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/afflicted.lua",
      "source": "Some walk in shadow, alone, unloved, unwanted. What powers they wield may be mighty, but their names are forever cursed.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "有些人行走于阴影之中，孤独、无人关爱、不被需要。他们掌握的力量或许强大，但他们的名字永远受到诅咒。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "e0a9c308c6af71774f8d5ac629f0d7bf9bf7b49b2b1f65b8d345deb3ac455a63",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0039 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/afflicted.lua",
      "source": "Worse, any who approach the Cursed can be driven mad by their terrible aura.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "更可怕的是，任何接近被诅咒者的人，都可能受其可怕光环的影响而发狂。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "5e5286c5a89b0e0b9566b9f557df150dacd530402132b4713a168922b61ab9e9",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0039 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/celestial.lua",
      "source": "They can channel the power of the Sun to smite all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们能引导太阳之力，痛击一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "5c5ac63ddbddf2fb7f0afcd073c7029b49e7dcd2a498bc813c9cd0297aaea475",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0039 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/afflicted.lua",
      "source": "Affliction can run to the soul, and hatred can fill one's entire being. Overcome someone else's hated curse to know its dreaded meaning.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "痛苦可以深入灵魂，憎恨可以充斥整个身心。战胜他人身上那可憎的诅咒，方能领会其可怕的含义。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "1e8ba1d2b11ffd7b4ff86046029c70cc4f072b8f89964b60b6ef9474e44fe889",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0039 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/celestial.lua",
      "source": "They can channel the power of the Sun and the Moons to burn and tear apart all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们能引导太阳与月亮之力，灼烧并撕裂一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "9908e959c7acb91ef5ef4963eac67b900b1d1ad57dc5e52539c1c85ecabc957f",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0039 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/celestial.lua",
      "source": "Masters of Sun and Moon magic, they usually burn their foes with Sun rays before calling the fury of the stars.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "他们是日月魔法的大师，通常先用太阳射线灼烧敌人，再召唤群星之怒。"
    }
